text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Vinti at RSNA who walked me through the work you're doing at
[COMPANY] around Cone Beam CT AI - super interesting.

I'm actually working with most medical imaging AI teams out there (Viz.ai,
Curemetrix, Philips, etc) and have not encountered a use case like yours
yet.

I'm curious how you're managing the data pipeline especially around
segmentation, QA workflows, etc..

Thought we could use this time early in the quarter to catch up and swap
notes before things quickly ramp up later.

My Friday's pretty open right now if you have 15mins to chat?

subject: We've recently partnered with Tractable & UVEYE | Vehicle Inspection AI
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I'm reaching out as we've recently onboarded both Uveye & Tractable to help scale their data curation & annotation pipelines. Just like Claim Genius they're leveraging vision models for vehicle visual inspection use cases (damage detection, value appraisal, etc) . 

They mostly came to us due to concerns about the competitiveness of their model quality and delivery speed as they started to scale. Not sure how familiar you are with Encord, we're a data development platform built for advanced computer vision teams to build better models (~5 years old, 100+ employees, $50M+ funding). We actually just raised our Series B a few months ago! 

Given the work we're doing with the teams at UVEYE and Tractable, I thought it'd make sense for us to briefly swap notes. Open to a quick call this week or the next? My Monday and Wednesday are looking pretty open right now.

subject: [Encord] Moxi | Data Labeling
text:
Hi [NAME],

I'm a big fan of your work on Moxie. Congratulations to you and your team
on reaching 100k elevator rides. I'm sure that number has since climbed.

I work with a few other leaders in the robotics space (Pickle, Rapid,
Novarc) on their video annotation projects. They were looking for native
video annotation tooling to increase annotation accuracy/model performance,
particularly for tasks like picking and material handling.

Curious: Are there any labeling projects on the horizon?

subject: Scaling up Geospatial AI at xFarm
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed that you are currently hiring for a Geo AI Data Scientist - & was curious to understand how you're thinking about managing your Computer Vision data pipelines as you scale, following your very impressive Series C raise. 

We work with a number of leading Geospatial AI teams (including Sentera, Geospatial Intelligence & LiveEO), whose Heads of AI were frustrated by slow development cycles hurting their ability to introduce new products.

That's why we built Encord: to help AI teams remove training data bottlenecks by focusing on data curation, annotation, & active learning, so they can realise new revenue opportunities, faster. 

Open to learning more?

subject: Congrats on the raise! - AI Data Quality
text:
Hey [NAME],

I hope all is well! Congrats on the recent Series B round and excited to
see what comes next at [COMPANY].

I'm actually working with most logistics robotics teams out there (Baker
Hughes, Pickle Robot, RIOS Intelligent Machines, Rapid Robotics and
Slamcore, etc.) and developing a few hypotheses around training data
quality for AI models.

I'd love to get your thoughts on these pieces and swap notes about what
I've been seeing in the space. Would you be open to a quick virtual catch
up this week or the next? My Wednesday's looking pretty open right now.

Hope that you had a cozy holiday season,
